mechanics.claim: Dark Matter deals damage after a delay when it strikes the target location, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: casts down a mass of dark matter that strikes the target location after a {{rutngt|1.2}} {{tt|delay|from the start of the cast time}}

mechanics.claim: The impact delay begins at the start of the cast time, not after the cast finishes.
mechanics.quote: The delay starts at the beginning of the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Dark Matter's cooldown is reduced based on stacks of Phenomenal Evil Power rather than following a flat per-rank cooldown.
mechanics.quote: ''Dark Matter's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced based on stacks of ''{{ai|Phenomenal Evil Power|Veigar|Phenomenal Evil}}''.

mechanics.claim: Dark Matter still lands and deals damage even if Veigar dies during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: If '''Veigar''' dies during the cast time, ''Dark Matter'' will still successfully fall from the sky.
